description: This file is a shell script that defines functions for creating and applying git patches with specific subject line preservation tests. It sets up various test cases to verify behavior of subject preservation in patches using git format-patch and git am.

methods.name: make_patches
methods.description: Creates patches with specified subject types and subjects, then stores them in patch files.

methods.name: check_subject
methods.description: Checks out a patch and verifies that the commit message subject matches the expected value.
